From my personal experience 

- Requires E2/3
- L OE is really nice to have, but luxury
- Hold Long Blade in Hand
- L if no Long Blade, use Defense to draw it
- Play Short Blade off rip (or whenever possible,) up to 3 times
- L once marked Gold, play Short Blade into Long Blade to combine and fuse into Whalefall
- L which in Turn, would also unlock your Exalt
- If incapable of using Exalt (or you want to use OE instead,) play Deadly Duel to use the Aliemus of her Allies to Battery herself
- Use Exalt / OE, only when you are guaranteed to die due to a lot of Damage

On Astral Reign Rule-Set
- Equip Mouse Posse 
- Keyflare Rouse GLotan
- Cast GLotan Rouse
- L can let it Retain in your Hand, as PChaos gives all Keyflare Rouses Prepare 1
- L which can allow you to activate the Rouse of either of your Awakeners, as well as immediately release your equipped Rouse 
- Whenever possible, activate Triad Revolution
- To generate Keyflare, play as much Cards as possible from your Awakeners for the first time in each Turn

60 pulls for character guaranteed 50/50. Guaranteed to get rate-up banner next 50/50 if you missed the first time. 

Weapons are same. 

Most characters don't need dupes to function, but there is a decent power-boost. They also don't need their weapon to function, but same, there is a power-boost. 
Characters can have up to 3 dupes to max rank. Weapons can have up to 12 -- no one ever really goes for it on banners.

Overall though, the game is extremely generous and over time you'll get the characters you want/need. 
The new 'limiteds' don't get added to standard banner pool for a while though, which means that you can't get spooked by them and their rerun might not be for a while.
